snippet.title: TWIN FLAMES ANNOUNCEMENNT TRAILER
snippet.description:
TWIN FLAMES is a turn-based cooperative puzzle adventure game where players control two characters, Savitri and Satyavan, on a hex grid. Their goal is to reach a destination tile while navigating obstacles and altering the environment. 

The characters are on a quest to attain the twin flame state, an intense connection thought to be the other half of one's soul, a higher form of soulmates. However, their path is challenging, filled with puzzles that test their worthiness of the twin flame bond. Players must communicate and coordinate effectively to ensure both characters can traverse the hex grid and reach their destination.

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084560/TWIN_FLAMES/
